mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero in periods where GDPC1 YoY falls below -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that boosts wage inflation, which erodes corporate margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when UNRATE < 3.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month moving average of FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% while CPIAUCSL rises above 4% signals a restrictive monetary regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when both FEDFUNDS MA(6) > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when INDPRO falls >1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) increase below 50,000 persons signals weak labor market momentum, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when PAYEMS monthly change < 50,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when RSAFS falls >3% over 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index (HOUST) exceeding 2% signals weakening real estate demand and lower corporate earnings for homebuilders, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly below zero when HOUST falls >2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
